t: Is she willing to give us the Ambrosia? And help us fight Nihaz?

quests: We are all part of the cycle of life

t: I hope I won't regret joining you in this venture...
It’s about time we kick these rats out of here!

Quarr! For the whole of July, I will help visitors launch their lanterns twice per hour, and my brother Chik-Rick will catch them at the other end of the bay. It's so beautiful, especially in the dark!

To make a lantern, you need two things: an empty turtle shell and a fern flower.

You can look for shells on the shore, and fern flowers - like the one in my right hand - can be found in the jungle.

Once you have everything, you can make a lantern. Or better yet, make several!

Quarr! When the time is right, release your lanterns into the water here by my side.

They will float across the bay straight to my brother Chik-Rick. But their flame can go out on the way! Follow your lanterns and keep the flame in them alive.

If at least one lantern makes it to Chik-Rick, you will get seashells and sparklets. And the more lanterns get there, the greater the reward!
Quarr! It's time to launch the lanterns!
We launch lanterns twice per hour. Come back here when it's time.
Are you here to help or to cause trouble...?
I swear the fruit was right there! Where did it go? I tried to find it but it just vanished. I don’t know what to think. Help me find it!
My oh my, how in the world could this happen? Tekyan never spilt blood of another Tekyan! Not even after our gods were gone, and left us in the cold and dark.

I'd thought we were alone in this snowy land, but now I know there's another settlement of the likes of us in the North, beyond the mountain. They are our former neighbors in Tequatl. However, we didn't recognize them, when they showed up. They are not calm and wise Tekyan, like they used to be. They are hateful and mad! They came about shouting about the Light, started crashing our homes, chopping down trees and spilling our blood... They obviously wanted us to abandon Genlun and pray to their new idols. Who are they? New immortals? They are indeed immortal - I've seen their wounds heal and the dead rise. Who did this to them? Who turned them into monsters? For the sake of the sanity, please, save us, let these crazy ones go!
What? What paws? What tail? Every other crocodile has got tails and paws. The most wondrous of him were his whiskers! Long, silky and really beautiful! Whiskers make Genlun’s image real!
Wow! I can clearly see him now! As if he were here himself! Let’s roll!
h: Tell them what Genlun looks like

t: Hey! You want a souvenir? Go on, choose what you like!

Hello stranger! Welcome to our village! Please don't be afraid if you hear explosions. Those are fireworks in your honor!

If you want to launch your own firework, you can buy it from us. What do you say?
Let's make some noise in the sky!

h: Ask for a carrot for the nose

t: Are you sure you want to bind to this location?
Hello there! How can I help you?

I know you! You’re the Tequatl hero! They’ve got a whole poem about your deeds!

We need your help again! Listen to what happened the other day. We went to beds at night, and in the morning it got so cold, like in the freeziest of the winters. Ice on the ground, no tea herbs, no rice plants, sour cherries instead of our dear sweet oranges... Animals are still in forests, alright, but we’re not so skilled at hunting yet, and our provision supplies are running out. Help us survive, oh great hunter! Get us meat and furs! Bring them to our elder, Che Kak, he’ll distribute them evenly among us. Or may be you can even work out a plan on how to return us home, eh?

Quarr! I'll tell you the rules - listen carefully.

Everything will take in July. Not before and not after! Remember that! Do not dawdle or you'll miss everything!

Once an hour a large bonfire burns. And you come and dance with everyone. Watch for the hints and do as they say immediately. Do not think! The more correct moves, the better.

Then whirl around! Spin! And pick up the lights. But pick them up quickly, or you won't have enough.

Once you are done, you get your reward. Then wait and come back in an hour. Or when you're in the mood.

What is bonfire dancing? What do you think? It's our ancient tradition. Every July the tribe gathers, makes a big fire, then dances.

For what purpose? A bonfire is a particle of the hot sun. The sun shines - life continues, everyone rejoices.

Quarr! Pay attention to the hints that the fiery spirit gives you, make the right moves, avoid mistakes. Then spin like the sun in the sky and pick up the lights.

If you do everything right, you will be rewarded.

Remember: this dancing takes place only in July. Then it will be over until next year.
Dancing will start soon! Hurry up! Don't be late! It's time to dance and earn sparklets!
Quarr! This is not the right time for dancing. Wait until the time comes. It takes place every hour.
I will help you bind your Adventurer's Stone to this location.
Greetings. How may I help you?
Don't step on the lawn! Don't step on the lawn!

Hello there. So, what do they want from me now? I bet they missed something, as always! ...Oh, please don't mind my chatter, it doesn't matter at all... Well, I must thank you for your service. These documents are very important. Please take my reply to Kavelin.
You have come to do what? You've nothing to do here! Gitmek! The Grand Vizir said kill and destroy, and if you don't like it - it's off with your head!
What? You dare threatening me? I will rip off your skin and make a drum out of it!

If it weren't for Outlander, Kiela would never see home again. Kiela no forget you. Name my first child in your honor!

No, wait, the first child is the sacrifice to the spirit of fire... I name my second child in your honor!
Nice dance, Outlander. Hissit-Asha-Shi is satisfied.
Do as the Children of Light do.

quests: From the Light to the Shadows

t:
Didn't expect to see me here? But like everyone else, I resurrected as soon as I was released from Nihaz's box.

We should all be grateful to our mistress Hirkalla for helping us cast off the shackles of death. I will lead her unstoppable Swarm against her enemies!

As for you, maybe you know what happened to my brother? Where is my brother, Roman Swordson...?
Do you believe in the power of insects, traveler? Even now I hear the voice of the Swarm, calling to me from the depths of the Astral...
Beasts! Locking a friend in a cage! This is unbelievable. I, oh I mean, you are going to avenge me!

Robbery and assault! We goblins are peaceful, just digging here for ore... Since orcs and Xadaganians left this place, saying the mine is empty, but there's plenty of gold ore left. It's enough for us, in any case.

Goblins are quite laborious, so we scrupulously separated the remaining gold from dust, and carefully put the gold in crates. But there was a scum among us, Ghim the Greedy is his name. He gathered a ganged and broke into the mine riding guess what? I bet you can never guess! He was riding a huge cave troll!

So, he got into the depth of the mine and triggered a few stone jams, you know, to block out the chasers. Smart scum, eh? Like all goblins are!

But nevermind the stone jams. We've got a couple of bombers here, Dub and Step, they're going to help you clear them up. Dub's been around here, while Step went to search the caves, so you'll have to find him. Help us. We goblins can be grateful, you know.

Here comes another walking purse... Agrh!

[The beast's hoarse voice turns into ferocious roaring. The beast roars emotionally, gesturing as though it's trying to tell you something. You should probably address your questions to Captain Solonus.
Argh, argh, argh! Rrragh! Rragh, argh, argh!

quests: Helping the Ghost Hunters: Tough Choice

t: I think you can beat me? Your courage is fascinating.

You are not worthy of fighting me!

My warriors will destroy you, and then I will drink wine out of your skulls!
Well... Let sacred combat decide who's in the right!
You’re not like the people of the Whitestone City. Spirit is weak in their stone bodies. What’s driving you? Why are you helping them?
I am here to educate citizens about various important matters. How may I be of assistance?

When the great Nezeb disappeared, Yasker became his successor. Day and night he sits in the Tower and thinks about how to best serve the citizens of the Empire. The Great Yasker is always happy to talk to ordinary citizens, but appointments must be booked in advance. The current wait time is approximately two years.
You can learn new skills from combat and magic trainers in Yasker's Tower. They work twenty four - seven and will gladly share their knowledge.

Economic system, in general, and commercial relations, in particular, are well-developed in the Empire. You may find traders and vendors on every corner of the city. There are also a lot of them in Yasker's Tower. Satisfaction guaranteed!

The Empire is famous for its craftsmen and wonderful things they create. You have a chance to become one of them, if you like. All you have to do is undergo a course with one of them. Trainers await in Yasker's Tower twenty four - seven and will gladly share their knowledge.

Government, authorities and embassies are located in the capital of the Empire. Any citizen is free to visit the Yasker's Tower and see with their own eyes where the City Counsil, Imperial Sentinels and Trinity Church are, take a look at orcish and Zem embassies. We are open to all the Imperial people!

Auction House is inside Yasker's Tower. You may sell or purchase rare and valuable items there.
Postal Service is used to send and receive messages, items and currencies. You can find a lot of postmen around the city.
There's an Astral port in the Northern part of Nezebrgad. It is widely used in military and transport purposes. You may use it to go on vacation or join a mighty quest.
The Light will shine on you, child.

As a friend, I will reveal to you the reason for my stay here. I am appointed a member of the local government. I have an order to investigate this district; and, moreover, the promptings of my own conscience will not permit me to overlook those malicious, ignorant persons who so abominably misuse the absolute power they wield over their people.

I can't. I can't, gentlemen. I confess that the moment an official a single rank higher than myself speaks to me, my heart stands still and I get as tongue-tied as though my tongue were caught in the mud.

These mountains have always been ours! And we will not tolerate strangers here, goddess or not - we recognize no one's authority! We knew other gods, great stone gods who watched over these mountains in the days of the world's youth...
There's my favorite customer! Would you like a drink?
The locals say they saw huge creatures near the fortress. There’s an orcs’ camp in the north, so that must have been mountain trolls.

Greetings, seekers of history! I am offering you unique artifacts from ancient Hickut, just unearthed from the graves! Each item is a piece of history. Take a fragment of the past with you, and give it a new lease on life... in your wardrobe!

h: I was instructed to take what you owe to Ilya Oblomov...

t: Writing? Me? I haven't written at the office for the last two days: as soon as I sit down to it, my left eye begins to run, I must have a cold in it; and my head swims if I bend down.

I'm glad it's all over! I was so scared. And now this awful Eurial is captured, your friend is unharmed, the Ball is over, and everyone is alive. Someone could've been poisoned. I'm glad it didn't happen!

But I must say this adventure could use more of our brave Aviaks. If I ever tell this story to anyone, I'll make Atis, Potis, Amis, and Ivok the main characters, sorry. Ivok especially, yes.
If this elf and Lisa are going to wed, then I need to bake some pies! Because what kind of wedding doesn't have pies?

My employer Hugh de Pluie sent me here. He managed to buy old goods at a bargain, and now he wants me to charge triple for them. Of course, you are not obliged to buy them, but where else can you get all that? I'm sorry, but such are the trade rules.
The rocket is a real work of art. Just like it is aiming for the starry sky, we strive to understand ourselves.
Hurry. The Council is about to start.
h: We must return to the Observatory

t: You must look like the local guard. Steal their uniform and take their positions. When the time comes, you must make sure every member of the Conclave survives. Don't let Tensess and Nezeb kill anyone - or one another, which is even more important!
Oh Sarnaut gracious, how could you lose a dozen sets of gear? Anyway, here are a dozen more.
h: Listen, here's the thing. We've lost the gear.

t: Our world is a grain in the ocean of Creation. Maybe in this place you can comprehend the scale of the Universe and walk among the distant stars.

I did not doubt you. I will preserve this knowledge in the immense chambers of my memory.

And on the pages of the book, of course.

It's over there, on the table.
h: I found the Echoes of Power... Power from other worlds!

t: As I understand it, de Doucer saw necromancy as a tool of acquiring more prestige. I have nothing against the Dark Arts - they are no more dangerous than any other weapon in good hands. However, Armando and his clique turned to Vampirism... In other words, they gave up their minds. Since that day, his life started to unravel and eventually ended in the City of Demons. Pity, because the boy was a talented one.
h: Tell me about Armando de Doucer.

t: The last June hero! In the time period picked by the Observatory he is the powerful entity that you encountered in the Dead City. Another victim of Nihaz’s plans... No, I’m not in a position to judge you. The whole story perplexes me. The Wormfaces could be our allies in this battle.

Cairage is alive and well. I've been told he tried to rebel against the Demonologists on Sogot. He didn't like their methods, and I can't say I don't agree with him... Quite a few heads rolled - demons, Demonologists - before they managed to imprison him. Just imprison! They couldn't kill him... or perhaps they didn't want to. You'll have to do it yourself.

The origins of the conflict between the League and the Empire are lost in the dark mists of time. We know it started with the rivalry of two mages, Nezeb and Tensess, who used to be close friends. What caused it? It is unknown.

Many believe it was Nezeb's greed for power, others blame Tensess and his indecisiveness. And even fewer people mention a third person – one who divided the two friends, ensuring that they went their separate ways. Only one thing is certain – one day a quarrel broke out between them. It was a sad day for the entire world.

Your are going to witness this conflict... and take part in it.
h: Tell me how Nezeb left the Conclave.

t:
It is an interesting episode. I find it hard to find the time slice it fell out from. I gather, it's one of the alternative events of the near future.

Here is the end of templar Hiero's story. The poor fellow lost his entire family and turned to Light, longing to return his loved ones by the power of his own faith alone. Alas, it isn't the way the Gift of the Light works! Hiero's despair only led him to the edge of insanity and opened the door for the Darkness in his heart. And the door to our world.

A, Fiery Father. The last idol of the Draconids. A magnificent creature, though I don’t harbor any warm feelings for it. He died a silly death for foolish reasons instead of protecting the Draconids and helping us in our battle against Nihaz. We could use his omnivorous flame.
h: Tell me about the Great Dragon.

t: This can't be good... Maverick should have never appeared in the Whirl, under no circumstances. I'm afraid, it isn't even a trip to the past, it's... I don't know. This creature is immortal and unpredictable, as well as many other Planar Rim emanations. Even I stay away from this place. Be careful...
h: Tell me more about Maverick, the Walker of Secret Paths

t:
Yes, we must. I'm also wondering where the Observatory could find this... script. It looks like it's fond of alternative realities now. This can't be good...

I'm not the one to tell you how dangerous I am if you ever dare confront me. I don't think I can give you advice. Maybe, you should stop before it's too late.
h: We must talk about the Fourth Whirl.

t: Long, long time ago in the Winter Palace... Actually, only a couple of years ago. There was a minotaur, who, if you'll pardon the expression, wasn't too smart, just like most representatives of his race. But he was exceptionally greedy. This was his undoing. I'm sure you remember the story. You put an end to it.
h: Tell me about Hoof, the traitor minotaur

t:
It could be funny if it weren't sad. Everyone remembers how oversusceptible mortals established our beloved Sculptor's cult.

Architect, our friend, took this phenomenon in cold blood. He just let it be. "Watching the unusual behavior," he said. There's no need to remind you how it all ended... The Observatory will tell you the story.
h: Tell me about the Prophet, the mastermind of fanatics

t: Our world is a grain in the ocean of Creation. Maybe in this place you can comprehend the scale of the Universe and walk among the distant stars.

The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Ath-Zak.

Second Whirl: Great Dragon.

Third Whirl: Armando de Doucer.

Fourth Whirl: Cairage.
h: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

t:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Catherina's fall.

Second Whirl: Death of Hickut.

Third Whirl: Nezeb leaving the Conclave.

Fourth Whirl: Hiero.
h: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

t:
The Observatory made its choice:

First Whirl: Hoof

Second Whirl: Prophet

Third Whirl: Maverick

Fourth Whirl: Cosmos
h: Who is hiding behind the Whirls now?

t:
Oh, it's recent. I'm sure you know everything from your stay at Umoir. But now you can see it with your own eyes.

Don't let Catherina know that you saw it. You shouldn't sting her conscience again.
h: Tell me how Catherina got under Sarn's influence.

t:
Hickut's death is well documented. The Zem people are very meticulous when it comes to history.

Tep has brought enough trouble on this world. Observatory will show you a battle between a handful of brave people of Hickut and the crazy Necromancer's machinarium. Nobody survived this slaughter... except Tep. And he isn't what you would call a victor.
h: Tell me how people of Hickut died.

t: Great deeds are waiting for us, friend.

quests: Journey to the End of the World
Between the Future and the Past

t:
A great occasion for celebration.

But remember – our enemy is close. I'm afraid there'll be no joyous days in our future.

I'll send a message to you soon. Be prepared.

, I've noticed your leaders have become somewhat... overconfident? Do they think Nihaz is finished?

That's not the case, I'm afraid. You have only dealt with his minions. The Citadel itself is still under his control.

Aidenus, Catherina, and Yasker - what are they planning? You don't know? Neither do I. That troubles me. In their quest for power, they forget that we all serve one purpose. There shouldn't be any quarrels between us. I should remind them of the consequences of disobedience...

Alright, don't let me keep you from the festivities. Let's celebrate the Anniversary.

I don't need the Observatory to see who you are and why you're here. The supreme good, you say. I say, hypocrisy. It doesn't matter, who you obey and who you serve. How is "your" Cosmos any better? Is it because he preserved the Aoidoi's free will? Allowed Sarnaut history to run its course? Freedom is a faulty principle. Freedom is the matter of Chaos.

Look at me. What I managed to achieve! Look at my accomplishments! They're mine! If my purpose requires blood, even if it's blood of my own people, so be it.

Give up. While you can.

Hello, nekhens! If the freedom of expression is what you're after, and you are looking for a style that follows no rules, then welcome! I have the unique apparel here, one that allows you to be yourself. Let's make the world more diverse, together!

Ba-a-ah... Thank you, ba-a-ah...

Are you looking for the treasure huntress?

She was here, ba-a-ah... Asking around about the June ruins. That's a ba-a-ad place. There's evil in the ruins!

Marianna is good, ba-a-ah... Bu-u-ut now she's gone! They came in the middle of the night and took her, ba-a-ah... I don't know who. This piece of cloth is all that's left, ba-a-ah...
h: Hello! I have a present for you. Where can I find a girl named Lara?
Give me this piece of cloth.

t: Stra-a-anger... What do you want, ba-a-ah?
Cuarr! Wingless stranger! I did not see you here before, but you fought that scum who came from the other side of the mountains. Where do you come from? Who you fight for? Speak, now!
Are you ready to solve my riddles, my friend?
Let’s start with the easy one. What is the value of pi?

quests: Water of Life and Water of Death

t:
Glob will blow this blockage into pieces, believe it!
All he has to do is light a match. Just wait until we get there - you'll witness a boom the likes of which you've never seen, as the whole tunnel turns to dust!
So, let's roll?
Let's set it all to pieces, Step!

So many steps... Our destination is at the end of this hall. It’s an immense burial chamber where the heroes of Umoir rest.  Judging by how the mission has gone so far, I think everything should be pretty quiet. Well, should we move?

h: We need to go search for Canaan’s grave!

t:
Yes, he was talking about me.

Who else did you expect to see? Tep?

Unfortunately, there is no one else who would agree to help with this. I still had some hopes for the imperial Necro-Incubator, but those in the employ of the Empire don’t fly to Umoir  – their bureaucracy is stronger than the power of Cosmos.

Do I like what we’re doing? No! But remember – we have no other option.

If we don’t raise an army of the dead, we’ll be wiped away! Only those who manage to flee will survive.

So... let’s forget about moral codes and just do what needs to be done.
h: Are you the necromancer Zayan spoke of on the Council?

t: Long years of exile taught me how to survive.

I’m waiting for you. But perhaps you should go talk to Zayan first. Although necromancy is my specialty, no one understands all the subtleties of the Game of the Gods and the Show better than that old man. He’ll explain what we need to do next.

Yes, I’m aware why you’re here! Don’t bother telling stories. If we succeed, there will be far more interesting companions here. If you're ready – I wouldn't waste any time and could send you to Gipat right now.
We definitely weren’t ready for that. Tell me, how did the fight inside the Outpost go?

Wow! Did you say the Templars forgot about the siege and started helping you fight the demons?!

Although that is easy to explain, without the watchful eye of their holier-than-thou commanders, they quickly realized who the real enemy was...

Either way, we sustained serious losses! We were lucky the Templars’ goal was not to destroy the Outpost, but to kill the undead – we quickly repaired the damage. Most of the dead "living" joined the ranks of our army...
No one could resurrect – both the Templars and the demons aimed for the kill...

But we were saved because our troops had time to gather their strength by the time the attack came, because everything happened outside the gates of the Outpost was... Anyway, it’s good you missed it.

So he couldn’t just tell us? Too far to walk? Well, fine, let me read what the old man wrote...

Hmm... Okay-okay. Interesting...

A controversial but effective solution... It should work. At least at first glance I can’t see anything that would interfere. Getting into the Mound right now is no problem. There shouldn’t even be any risks except the occasional ghost.

I recovered my strength. We can be on our way. Are you ready yourself?

h: I think I need to rest.
Yes, this needs to be done now.

t: It's good to see you, my dear friend.

Greetings, .

I've heard what happened at the Great Ball. Well, now you probably understand why I'm not fond of politics. My father is too obsessed with his intrigues and machinations to pay attention to the people around him.

I'm afraid his scheming will backfire in the end. Of course, Zayan will help Skulnar, but what happened at the Ball will hardly strengthen the alliance we need to oppose Nihaz.

But maybe they'll forget about their quarrels just for one night?

Greetings, .

I've heard about your deeds. Alas, I myself have nothing new to boast about: the endless siege of Nihaz's Citadel is starting to become tiresome. Every day we send the dead to storm the next entrance, giving you the opportunity to get in from the other side.

Fortunately, the cemeteries of Sarnaut are almost bottomless - there's no shortage of the undead. Capable Summoners, too.

The vampires of the House de Doucer, those who joined Annette, also provide invaluable assistance. Wigo has few supporters these days.

Hopefully, sooner or later the siege will be over. My presence is demanded by business on the Kanian Archipelago where Svetlana seems to be having some problems.
Unbelievable... It's unbelievable! I have never seen so many undead. That's not all. More are coming.
Much better already! I was in plenty of fights when I was alive, but I could only dream of the fight that’s coming! See, even my soldiers are in a mood for war!

I never thought I’d see anything like this. This is Nihaz’s Citadel, you say? It’s huge!

Well, let's get this over with. As they say – the sooner we start, the sooner we’re done.

I’m so curious to see what awaits us inside.
h: What do you think of the assault?

t:
What can I say?

I fought in life, and I’ll fight now. I had enough rest. That elf, Dakkar, explained everything about why you’re here. And when we were in Sarn’s service... I learned a lot. So, you want to get rid of Nihaz? And you're mustering the dead to do it?

Yeah, in our day the dead generally laid in graveyards instead of marching across the land. They’re not great warriors, but we managed with far worse. At least they don’t question orders. You know what our quartermaster said: “If you’re smart – you’ll do good. But even a diamond helmet won’t help a fool.”

Anyway, go get to work.
h: What do you think about what happened?

t: What do you want from me?

Well, we all made mistakes. We have to admit it. We thought we were fighting Nihaz, but this god led us straight to his Citadel by sending us these coordinates.

Now our army serves Hirkalla... For what purpose? Who knows... She speaks of the gods of Light and Order, tyrants from other worlds who do not tolerate dissent and apostasy. What if they are a greater threat to Sarnaut than she is?

Greetings! Yes, we happened to meet in battle. Even though I lost, the same force brought me back to life, and it will be like this every time.

We left Jigran because we could no longer control the undead. But Skrakan needs us to serve the Great Mages. There are many dangers in the world. Swords are needed everywhere. Have you ever heard about the witches' coven? And they are just as dangerous as Tep. Morrana wanted the Scroll of Tensess for herself, and the Dale witches tried to get their hands on Urd's Folio. Who knows what else they are up to? Witch hunters told me a story how witches from the coven commit atrocities on distant allods...

Greetings! You and I fought against the nihilists and the Paladins... But every battle comes to an end.

We left Jigran because we could no longer control the undead. But Skrakan needs us to serve the Great Mages. There are many dangers in the world. Swords are needed everywhere. Have you ever heard about the witches' coven? And they are just as dangerous as Tep. Morrana wanted the Scroll of Tensess for herself, and the Dale witches tried to get their hands on Urd's Folio. Who knows what else they are up to? Witch hunters told me a story how witches from the coven commit atrocities on distant allods...
Ah, I'm itching for a fight... I remember how we walked through the glorious lands of Umoir, performing feats and fighting against the servants of the demon. It wasn't that long ago...
What a glorious battle! Our squad took a few hits during the landing. But thanks to you, we made it.

quests: Dark Vigor: Ghosts near the Cathedral

t: We prefer to fire our cannons from afar. Our sophisticated devices provide great support in battle. We never get onto frontline. Combination of magic and high-tech is what makes us dangerous!

Why? Look around you! Stinky idols, idiotic superstitions, and those people prostrate before anyone who can set fire to a rotten twig with a touch! I... I mean, my mentor intends to put a stop to this. There cannot be two moons and two queens on Umoir. I’ll eradicate all heretics and the rest of their vermin!
h: Tell me, why did the queen send you here?

t: ...The sorceress frowns and pretends that you are not there.

...Dalia reaches out and grasps your hand. You feel a pang of pain, the smell of a burnt skin...
When she lets go of you, you see the Firewing seal.

What are you looking at? Have you never seen an old orc? No surprise in that... We usually die in combat, when we are still young! But this... this is my blessing and my curse. But you’re not here to pity an old man. I’m still strong enough to crush your skull if I see you do that! Here’s the thing. Those idiots who have besieged the city talked my sons into joining them; they promised them glory, gold, respect... But I know their kind: they all come to a bad end! And my sons... well, they believed them. Listen to me. I’m not a living skeleton yet and I still have a shot in the locker. I will summon spirits who will help you defeat the leaders of the Daring clan, but you must promise me not to hurt my sons! They must live, do you get it? I will turn my power on you if you let them down!
Good. You’re strong, but my spirits will make you even stronger! And remember, I will sense the blood of my children in a thousand miles, and then... fear my wrath!
Let it be so. Once again orcs have doomed themselves...
Usual orcs’ life. A tribe against a tribe. One wins, another gets buried in the ground. Nothing to tell about...
I sense my master. He's coming, and his triumph will be glorious. Those who challenge him are mad, for Tep's power will be absolute.

h: Do you have something for me?

r107898.s: Special Agent of the City Council

t: I'm a peasant acquainted with letters, and I have tried for some time but I can't read a word.
...Kanian looks at you appraisingly. There is neither interest nor judgement in his stare.

Hello, if you mean it. My name is Velit Molotov. Yes, one of those from Siveria, damn them all.

They say you’re a great hero and all. Killed so many demons, architects, and what not - too many to count. Then what are you doing here? Protecting “peaceful” demons? Ha! PEACEFUL DEMONS!

Crazy...
We meet again. How can I help you?

quests: The Path to the Lower Isle

t:
After using the alchemic mortar, place the following ingredients inside: herbs with the required properties and auxiliary substances that you can buy from me.
The properties of the ingredients used must form a harmonious combination. If you can ensure that, you'll get a potion whose effect depends directly on how well-matched the properties are. Yet the brewing process can result in a failure. You need to be ready for that and not lose hope.
By increasing your skill level, you'll gain access to new, more sophisticated and powerful formulas. Try making exactly these potions: the more sophisticated the formula, the greater the increase in your skill. However, making potions of levels surpassed long ago won't help your development. Your skill level depends on your character level as well: you can't become a high-class master if you stop developing.

An occasional failure is inevitable, everybody knows that. Make sure to use the correct ingredients, the properties of which will result in something useful. It’s doubtlessly more rewarding to brew something good than just a portion of goo. Besides, even if you can’t use it yourself, you can always sell it at an auction!
Remember to use only high quality equipment. Upgrade it whenever possible. This will enable you to brew over one potion at one attempt. Pick up right herbs, and with a little luck, you might brew two different potions at once!
Use a herb as described in a recipe. If you ever see an unknown property, don’t let it scare you off - it will surely work for the future!
h: Ask about tips for experienced alchemists

t: Science never stands still, and that's especially true for alchemy. New discoveries replace common knowledge at a rapid pace! For example, the old alchemical absorbent has become outdated, and using this extremely unstable substance is now strictly prohibited. But if you still have some old absorbent, I'll take it from you for recycling purposes in exchange for two mandrake roots. Oh, that herb is magical! It can replace any component in a potion! So, do we have a deal?
h: Exchange Alchemical Absorbent for Mandrake Roots

t: Science never stands still, and that's especially true for alchemy. New discoveries replace common knowledge at a rapid pace! For example, the old flora distorter is no good any more. Truth be told, we've got an infestation of some "greens" that have been putting spokes in the herbalists' wheels on the pretext of environmental protection. That's why we had to stop utilizing the distorter. It was outlawed! But if you have some flora distorters left, I'm authorized to accept them for recycling purposes in exchange for mandrake roots. Oh, that herb is magical! It can replace any component in a potion! So, do we have a deal?
h: Exchange the Flora Distorter for Mandrake Roots

t: I am the product of your nightmares, the spirit of plague, the embodiment of the dark essence of the astral plane... It's not important who I was before. I am here only because the goddess of Darkness called me... And promised me worlds that I could devastate...

In the depth of the Astral, I heard her call. The Queen of Death came to Sarnaut, and I could not help answering the call. Now I must wait for the hour when allods will again be enveloped by the plague. Existence must be reborn...

I was born on the streets of the dead cities of Hickut, from the screams of the dying, and from the black winds that sow death. I was the terror, the scourge of the full-blooded cities of Kania, the deadly fear that drove the caravans of Ugra away from the infested oases. I saw bonfires in the steppes and abandoned villages among the ice of Isa...

r526124.s: Brotherhood of the Last Shelter Guard

t:
Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Alright, it looks like it really is time...

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Stand back or I'll bite you!

Yes! You took your time! They... have they stopped catching cats?

Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Fine. Listen. I've never believed the tales of the churchmen saying the demons were defeated once and for all. You'd have to lose your sense of smell and stay out of the Astral. There are demons roaming around!

But now you can rub their noses in the obvious! The Edge of Eternal Night - have you ever heard of it? It used to be a Place of Power, and now... it's some cesspit, I can smell it from here. Cultists and demons - that's who live there now, and they are advancing on other lands.

I suppose it will soon reach the upper circles of the League and the Empire. You and I can't kill all the demons in the world, but we have our own goal. Demon blood is a powerful remedy, and we need a supply of it. With luck, you can rip out a dead demon's heart - I know you did that on Asee-Teph. The heart is a source of blood, so it should last us a while.

I ask you to get these hearts. Of course, you shouldn't stick your nose in there if you're not ready. Gain some experience first. When the time comes, let me know.
h: I was sent from Asee-Teph, are you an agent of the Demonologists?

t:
Agrh... Woof, woof! Agrh...

Alright, it looks like it really is time...
I determined to tell the judges the whole truth, convinced that it was at once the simplest and surest way of justifying myself.

r347218.s: Please, report me, I'm a bug.

t:
We can only win if humans and demons join forces! So we'll have to wait for the right moment to advance from both sides at the same time! Would you like to know when that's going to happen? Check your calendar - all the details have been added to it.

Would you like to join my squad? When the time comes, just find me and fight beside me.

quests: Hirkalla's Decree: Assault on the Wandering Island

t:
It's good to meet you!

I'm a Relic Master. There are only a few of us in Sarnaut. I used to be a Blacksmith. But under the guidance of Aidenus himself, I was reforged, so to speak...

Well, what would you like to know about my job?

quests: Equipment Upgrading Tutorial: Scroll of Reinforcement
Getting to Know the Relic Master

t: Let me introduce myself. I'm Dmitry Razumihin, a simple student...
It's a pity I don't have enemies. I would hug them, press them to my heart, and forgive them without thinking, from the bottom of my heart.

This is an unplanned hole in the universe... Your mind is still too weak to understand these things. You can be near it, but don't get too close – best case scenario, it will compress you into a speck, and worse case –  your soul will eternally bounce between different universes.
What are you doing here? You’re not a ghost...
Hello there! How can I help you?
This place is very peaceful, but it can get a little rustic without the goods I have to offer.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: Among our clans are the Poor, the Nomadic, the Merry, and the Saltie! That doesn't sound like a lot, but we don't sit still, so there is enough of us everywhere. The Orcs don't like to sit still in general. Our carpet is a flower meadow, hehe. And in that meadow are our wagon, trusty rhinos, and booze!
h: Which clans report to the guest artists?

t:
What do you think? For two hundred years, our people have been suffering under Xadagan's rule! They don't let us live freely, they barely allow us to breathe, so it's time to cast off the shackles and be free like in the good old days when we could go where we wanted and do whatever we wanted!

It's the traveling actors who are bringing the shamans' words to the masses, hah! We secretly travel between the allods of the Empire! Many of our people left for the other tribes that are free! They bring news that a new leader will appear soon. He will unite all the Orcs and lead the new Horde to freedom!
h: What do the traveling actors think about the rebellion?

quests: Arrangement mutuel bénéfique : Des diamants pour Duchesse
Arrangement mutuel bénéfique : Un festin pour Duchesse

t: Oh, there you are! A beautiful day, isn't it?
What did he say? There is no greater honor than fighting for one's country. I would like to die in battle, riding a warhorse, flying like the wind.

quests: Everyone who completes the weekly quota of tasks from the Astral Fleet…

t:
This is so sweet! It is always pleasant to know that your work is appreciated.

Say hello to everyone from me!

quests: The Creator's Path: Servants of the Light
The Creator's Trails: Servants of the Light

t: Oh, bother... Today has been one trouble after the other. Why did I take those 10 rubles?

The Great Tree protected Howlem, and now, when it has weakened, our island is falling apart... With the last of our strength, we are holding together the pieces that are about to break apart, staving off the Void...

Savant is still imperfect, and it must construct certain structures which will allow other architects to travel to that layer. See those capsules near the walls? That's what they are used for. A little bit of magic, and they will work they should. Six of you will be able to enter the energy layer of Savant.

And be careful - it's not just a piece of an altered allod! It's the Archon's domain, and he sets the rules there.

Unfortunately for him, I'm here to break them.

I don't know why he needed to create his "subreality". Maybe, he cannot complete the process of ordering without it. Luckily, the physical and the energetic dimensions of Savant are tied together. If we do something to him in the energetic dimension, it will affect him in this dimension, too.

In what way? I have no idea. And we need to find this out!

Are you ready? You should be!

I can open up the way to the Archont. You just need to approach him and stay alive. It is just as difficult as it sounds, but I believe in you.
The higher you climb, the harder you fall. Congratulations - you have just taught an ancient truth to an ancient creature.

It was a remarkable creature. To create its own dimension and sustain it solely through willpower is something our Great Mages wouldn't dream to do.

This wasn't of much help for it anyway. This invasion can now officially be declared over! Well done!
Of course. Right after we level this place to the ground.

So he has broken into our world. Who is he? I have no idea. But the Archonts clearly needed him for some reason.

Whoever he is, we need to shut down the Path and don't let anyone else come in. If we fail this one, we will fail everything.
Are you sure you can do that? The fault is all yours if you can't!

Huh! The cannons of Eclipse could have fired on this fortress for ages with no visible result.

Anyway, I helped you get Eclipse inside, and now it will provide us support in battle. I assume that we need to reach the top of that tower.
Are you trying to get yourself killed? Well, as you wish.
Don't expect it to be easy.
It is crucial not to mix up the buttons.

Implements of war should be buried in the deepest abysm. The Astral will devour what's left of this Archont. Demons will tear it apart. Among all creations of Sarn, they must be hating the Architects more than anyone.

What an irony!
You're here, too, eh? Your finger's in every pie.
It costs me very little to be in multiple places at the same time. I hope some of the Aoidoi can learn this simple skill.

You again?

Metaphysics, huh. Well, you already know our world well. Of course, there are things you still don't understand, but at least you have mastered the basics.

Gods, astral... You'll learn more with time. If you live that long, haha!

h: We can go to the meeting now.

t: Well, well... What do we have here? Precious works of ancient elven art from the times before the Change? What a timely discovery - I'm feeling like destroying something beautiful!
The one who doesn't risk... lives long enough to see their grandchildren.

Well, well... The doors are locked, and no sign of the Sculptor. It looks like the principal culprit decided to avoid meeting the eager audience. What a shame! I hoped to have a little chat with that otherworldly creature, but instead we will have to sort out all the mess that he'd left behind.

Ascension Hall? Yeah, right. If anyone can ascend in there, it's your pal Sculptor, who escaped the lab on Ferris and brought his friends to Sarnaut - thanks to you and the Surveyors!

You think the fanatics had been cutting people up and trying to make homunculus out of them for no reason? I heard something when I was pretending to be a helpless captive, and I didn't like it at all...

I don't understand why the Sculptor had to complicate it all so much. Maybe he is incapable of believing himself, and had to use faith of others? Who knows...

Here, in the Ascension Hall, fanatics voluntarily sacrifice themselves and make sacrifices of their captives. They believe they can become "creatures of a higher order". Idiots! Their "deity", as well as their "religion" were invented by a crazy goblin - that's why they assembled this thing out of all sorts of trash they could lay their hands on. But the power of faith works miracles, and putting in enough effort can bring to life even a chair.

This is how fanatics' faith and sacrificial blood endowed a pile of old garbage with divine strength, and all the Sculptor had to do was to direct it. We need to put an end to this!
h: Ask what happens in the Ascension Hall

t: Ugh... Ugh... Wait, what? I'm a reasonable creature that understands the nuances of thanatology... Is there life after death? Yes or no?!

h: Do you have something for me?

t: Our village is relatively close to the city, but there are other, remote places...

So you're not one of them! Finally, someone remembered about us. Since Hoof showed up and took over Ivan's summer residence, we've been in trouble. The bandits were polite at first - they told us they were preparing the residence for the tycoon's arrival, but when those guys with scarfs on their faces came... They said, they were in charge! Which meant, they could steal, they could kill, and no one could do anything about that. There's that gang in the village right now - they're drinking, picking fights, hurting girls. No one can stick up for us! They took all healthy men to the castle, and here in the village only women and old men are left...
Hello there! How can I help you?
Out of the way, serfs! Before you is the dark princess! I poisoned my father, husband, brother and son in order to sit on the throne!

Enemy’s location: southeast - Wormfaces.

Enemy’s location: southwest - Gibberlings.

The ghost girl spent her days wandering the streets of the city, watching the living. She saw joy and sorrow, love and hate, and always sought to help those in need.

One night, when the city was shrouded in fog and darkness, Elise heard a faint cry. She followed the sounds and found a little girl who was lost in the dark. Without hesitation, Elise took the girl by the hand and led her to the safest place in the city - her mansion.

From then on, the little girl became a frequent guest at Elise's. They played together, talked and shared their secrets. For the ghost girl, this was the first time someone could see and hear her, and she was happy.
My cards foretold that I'd see you here. They also foretold excellent entertainment and crowds of people, and they were correct.

My cards foretold that I'd see you here. They also foretold excellent entertainment and crowds of people, and they were correct.

Perhaps you heard predictions about our future? Vampires, demons, all that nasty vermin. But don't you worry!

I saw good things, too. Like you having snowball fights and sledging this winter. You'll overcome everything, I'm sure of that.

My cards foretold that I'd see you here again, . They also foretold excellent entertainment and crowds of people, and they were correct.

Perhaps you heard predictions about our future? No? And there's something troubling happening on Suslanger... Don't worry, I believe everything will be fine.

I saw good things, too. Like you having snowball fights and sledging this winter.

So don't worry, everything will be fine. Just celebrate the Anniversary!
My premonition wasn’t wrong, I know it. The answer is hidden here...

Greetings!

The Eclipse is a unique ship, indeed. You know what I think?

The League chose our path in the end. The path of the Empire! Hasn't Catherina taken the path of technical progress? Hasn't she asserted her undivided authority? That's exactly what we, Imperial citizens, do!

As for the ships, be assured that we're building something even better right now. And we're planning a unique mission for a ship with a beautiful name Infinity. She will travel to the deepest layers of the Astral.

You're back on the Eclipse. , right?

The last time I told you that the Empire had bigger projects than this ship. The Infinity... Alas, Cosmos's recklessness had tragic consequences! Do you think we can trust him? After the events on Umoir, I highly doubt that. Don't worry, even the Great Mage of the Aoidoi stumbles.

As for the Orcs, we'll handle them, too. There are plenty of our forces on Izune - they'll keep the Shamans in check. We won't let them ruin the Empire.

But don't think about it now. Just enjoy yourself while there's still time.

Oh, it's you again!

I've received a report on your actions on Jigran... If they hadn't been sanctioned by Yasker, we would've had a serious talk!

However, I believe this Hirkalla would have resurrected Nezeb anyway, with or without your help. This has caused a lot of problems for the Empire. We have yet to sort out the Orc rebellion, and now we've lost contact with Nefer Ur. What is he planning there, in Xadagan? No one has a clue, even though we've sent plenty of agents to the Zem allod.

Are you ready to move on? I know I'm not. But I guess we don't have a choice.

I can try to affect the Architects' brains, or whatever it is they use to think. What do you say?
Oh... I'm not a fortuneteller, but I have a feeling that this is going nowhere good!

Are you ready to move on? I know I'm not. But I guess we don't have a choice.

I can try to affect the Architects' brains, or whatever it is they use to think. What do you say?
Oh... I'm not a fortuneteller, but I have a feeling that this is going nowhere good!

Ah, demon's spawn! Such a terrible headache...

Me and the prioress are exhausted. I will send my mental messenger with you to carry the remains of my strength. I hope it will help you. This monster is way too strong for me right now!
Wait a second... Here you go! Try not to die!

What advice can I give you? Hold the spear firmly! After meeting you, I understood one thing: war is your nature. There is something in your world that creates warriors.

Although we have been plagued by many disasters since you came to our world, I am glad I met you. Without you, we wouldn't have been able to defeat Hirkalla.
h: Do you have any advice for me?

t: Before we engage in what could be our last battle, you should talk to your friends and allies. Who knows if you'll get another chance?
God did not reward me with abilities but gave me a good heart, that's why people find me endearing.
